name: SpotifyArduino
description: Vendored copy of witnessmenow/spotify-api-arduino with the buffer-overflow fix in refreshAccessToken()/requestAccessTokens() and a new setBearerToken() public method. See ShiftDeck DEVELOPMENT_JOURNEY.md (Phase 5 attempt 8, Phase 7 reboot) and PATCH_NOTES.md for the exact diffs. Drop the override in platformio.ini (lib_extra_dirs = lib) and remove this directory if you want to go back to the upstream library.
